::: {.module-outcomes}
## What you will be able to do

- Detect and remove the anomalies that break BTYD inputs: returns and cancellations, missing customer IDs, non-product lines and same-day repeat orders.
- Show, against known truth, how much each anomaly biases BG/NBD and Gamma-Gamma estimates when left in.
- Cap extreme order values at a stated percentile and measure how the cap moves the spend parameters and CLV.
- Fit BG/NBD and Gamma-Gamma to UCI Online Retail II and check them on a holdout period.

**You leave with:**

- A tested cleaning pipeline that turns a raw transaction log into a BTYD-ready RFM table
- A table of parameter bias by anomaly on the dirtied synthetic log
- Holdout tracking and CLV for Online Retail II, with the cleaning choices stated
:::
